01 / Executive Profile

Where technology meets education and research.

Ishara Ubeykoon is an academic executive, technology strategist, software engineer and multidisciplinary researcher with more than 15 years of professional experience spanning higher education, software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, embedded systems, electronics, scientific research and institutional development.

As Head of Academic – Faculty of Computing at TBS International Campus, he leads academic planning, governance, programme development, quality assurance, accreditation, faculty development, industry engagement, research promotion and digital transformation.

Previously, he served as General Manager of the Ceylon Strategic Research Institute and as Head of Research of the Andromeda Research Consortium, leading multidisciplinary research and innovation across computing, engineering and applied sciences.
